conventions.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1], fractions of the PDF page (A4, incl. the white frame around the scan)

drawings.description: à droite de ces formules, un croquis : une région $C$ hachurée par deux familles de droites parallèles. Le signe devant $\operatorname{bnd}_D$ est bien une intersection sur la page, là où l'on attendrait une réunion
drawings.kind: region hatched by two families of parallel lines
drawings.notes: A region crossed by two families of parallel lines (four or five lines each, drawn as straight strokes), a faint wavy outline around it and a brace on the left; two small ticks inside the region. The wavy outline is schematised; the label C is not on the sketch itself (it is in the formulas).

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un croquis : une bande entre deux droites parallèles, un point marqué sur l'une, et une ligne brisée en zigzag entre les deux
drawings.kind: strip between two parallel lines with a zigzag
drawings.notes: Two nearly parallel lines bounding a strip, a marked point on the upper one (left end) with a tick to the right; from the point a broken zigzag line runs between the two lines (shape approximate).

drawings.description: à gauche, un petit croquis : quatre segments issus d'un point, dans un cercle, deux d'entre eux repassés à l'encre
drawings.kind: segments from a point inside a circle
drawings.notes: From a heavy central point, two strokes inked thick (up left, up right) and three thinner ones (down left, down, down right); around the point a thin irregular closed outline (the circle, drawn as a polygon) and two short strokes. Five segments are visible from the point where the transcription says four (noted).
drawings.disagreement: Five segments leave the central point on the facsimile (two inked heavily, three thin), not four.

drawings.description: croquis en marge gauche ; au-dessus, un premier croquis du même losange, raturé
drawings.kind: diamond x, y, y', z (Hasse diagram) with a struck first sketch
drawings.notes: Below: the diamond with x on the left, arrows to y' (upper) and y (lower), and from each an arrow to z on the right, labels as in the tikzcd of the transcription; a horizontal stroke with a cross at its left end above it (part of the first attempt, left as drawn). Above: the first sketch, heavily struck with zigzag hatching, drawn grey and schematised.
